title: General advice request for newbie
author: Digital_Scribbles
selftext:
Hey all: 

Had a few questions and requests for advice. I started trying to make this 2D top down Gothic Horror monster collector game a few years back, but got frustrated with the slow learning curve in Unity and kind of stopped (I'm not a game designer and software/design isn't my skill set). 

Anyway, with AI getting so useful, I decided to just get AI to teach me how to build the game in Unity by getting gpt to kind of co develop it with me and teach me how to get my vision into the game. I guess this would be vibe coding, though it still involved a lot of set up for me. 

Anyway, fast forward a couple hundred hours, and I got something that at least to my eyes looks pretty cool and unique. The lore (which I've always liked), is pretty in depth. The battle mechanics and balance are unique but relatively easy to follow. The artwork is all generated by AI, but I think has a cool sort of 2D high resolution pixel gothic horror feel.

I've truly enjoyed the project so far. 

I guess I'm just wondering if this is something likely to get crapped on when I show to others, or if everything I'm doing painstakingly is just going to be a prompt tomorrow, or if I'm still doing things the stupid/inefficient way by using AI more as a teacher/ideation comparison instead of finding a program that just creates in seconds what takes me hours to make even with AIs guidance. 

Not sure what all the questions are. Just want to get general advice.
